title: Hask · all ten at 3×
caption: Ten brand-new designs beside the CC0 pawn and knight. Judge: which two or three are Hask?

title: Hask · at game size
caption: All ten at 1× on the grass beside the pack. Judge: does each read as a reptile, and does any stand out as not Pixel Frog?

title: 1. Smokehouse Keeper
caption: Keeps the smokehouses at the reed-channel mouth and wears one: a three-tier thatch hat bound in brine-red twine with a hide vent, a leather apron, smoked sausages on a string. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 1. Smokehouse Keeper · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 2. Marsh Trapper
caption: Runs the trap lines past the last smokehouse: a cowl and cape stitched from patched hides, his eye in the dark of it, an iron jaw-trap swung low on its chain. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 2. Marsh Trapper · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 3. Salt-Barge Poleman
caption: Poles the salt barges down the reed channels: a broad ribbed reed cone wider than he is, a linen smock and brine-red sash, the barge pole held low across him. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 3. Salt-Barge Poleman · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 4. Block Butcher
caption: Breaks the carcasses at the Butcherblock hall: a floppy linen cap slumped down his head, gathered in a brine-red band; a stained leather apron; a cleaver hung blade-down at his side. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 4. Block Butcher · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 5. Hide Tanner
caption: Works the tanning pits and dresses like the guild master he means to be: a leather chaperon on a twisted brine-red roundlet sitting low on his shoulders; a scraped hide in a stretching frame, held low. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 5. Hide Tanner · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 6. Reed Smuggler
caption: Runs untaxed salt through the reed channels by night: a deep woven basket hat over his whole head, one eye glinting through its slit, a dusk-plum cloak, a shuttered lantern held low. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 6. Reed Smuggler · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 7. Fishmonger
caption: Cries the eel and salt-cod on the smokehouse wharf: a shiny oilskin sou’wester with its long back brim over his neck, a scale-spangled apron, two salt-cod hung by the tail, held low. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 7. Fishmonger · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 8. Salt-Caravan Elder
caption: Led the salt caravans across the flats for forty seasons: a tall linen head-wrap with a brine-red stripe and a salt crystal, its end down his back; a hide robe; a jointed reed cane. He stoops. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 8. Salt-Caravan Elder · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 9. Hook Porter
caption: Carries the sides of meat from the barges to the smokehouse hooks: a salt sack worn as a hood, its corner flopped back; a hide jerkin with a rope belt; a big iron meat hook swung low at his side. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 9. Hook Porter · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: 10. Weighmaster
caption: Keeps Butcherblock’s scale at the salt quay: a tall brine-red felt capotain with a bone band and brass buckle, a high-collared hide coat, the quay balance hung low with salt in one pan. Judge: would it pass for Pixel Frog's, and is it Hask?

title: 10. Weighmaster · motion
caption: The idle (the pack's squash and bob) and the tic, looped: does the tic say who he is?

title: Hask · his own bodies
caption: The top three before (shared tunic) and after (a body each), at 4×. Judge: does each body say who he is, and does it still fit beside the pack?

title: Salt-Barge Poleman · new body, motion
caption: A short oilcloth smock, a rope belt, a salt-crusted hem, bare scaled arm and legs; the pole set from behind his back into the water ahead. The idle and the tic, looped. Judge: does the body move with weight?

title: Reed Smuggler · new body, motion
caption: A low-slung cloak of hanging reed over a hunched back, two hidden pockets (salt peeks from one), a fringe at the ground; the far arm hidden. The idle and the tic, looped. Judge: does the body move with weight?

title: Marsh Trapper · new body, motion
caption: A patched hide vest laced over his belly scales, strapped hide leggings planted wide, the trap’s chain from his belt; his far fist on his hip. The idle and the tic, looped. Judge: does the body move with weight?
